source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?nC) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q23413 ; wdt:P17 ?c ; wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 10) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nC = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en,mul". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 264

country.match: Match each castle to its country.
country.odd: Three of these castles are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Tower of London
rows.description: castle in central London, United Kingdom
rows.hook: has housed the Crown Jewels and a famous flock of ravens beside the Thames

rows.label: Windsor Castle
rows.description: historic castle, royal residence at Windsor in Berkshire, England, UK
rows.hook: is the oldest and largest inhabited fortress in the world, a weekend home of the monarch

rows.label: Eltz Castle
rows.hook: perches on a rock above a forested river valley and has stayed in one family for centuries

rows.label: Bamburgh Castle
rows.description: Grade I listed historic house museum in Bamburgh, United Kingdom
rows.hook: stands on a basalt crag above the North Sea and was once a seat of Anglo-Saxon kings

rows.label: Edinburgh Castle
rows.hook: sits on an extinct volcanic rock and fires a one o'clock gun every day but Sunday

rows.label: Akershus Fortress
rows.description: former medieval castle in Oslo, Norway
rows.hook: guards a capital's harbour and has served as a stronghold, a prison and a royal burial site

rows.label: Arundel Castle
rows.description: castle in West Sussex, England, UK
rows.hook: looks like a storybook fortress and is the family seat of the Duke of Norfolk

rows.label: Bran Castle
rows.description: Medieval castle in Braşov county, Romania
rows.hook: is popularly linked with Dracula and perches on a rock in Transylvania

rows.label: Prague Castle
rows.description: castle complex in Prague, Czech Republic, dating from the 9th century
rows.hook: is recognised as the largest ancient fortified complex in the world, with a great cathedral inside

rows.label: Malbork Castle
rows.description: castle built in Prussia (now Poland) by the Teutonic Knights
rows.hook: was the headquarters of the Teutonic Knights and is among the largest brick fortresses in the world

rows.label: Bastille
rows.hook: was a fortress-prison whose fall became the symbol of a revolution

rows.label: Alnwick Castle
rows.description: castle and stately home in Alnwick, Northumberland, England, UK; seat of the Duke of Northumberland, England, UK
rows.hook: stood in for Hogwarts in the early Harry Potter films

rows.label: Stirling Castle
rows.hook: crowns a volcanic crag and was a favourite home of the Stuart monarchs

rows.label: Hever Castle
rows.description: Grade I listed country house in Hever, Kent, England, UK
rows.hook: was the childhood home of Anne Boleyn, second wife of Henry VIII

rows.label: Reales Alcázares
rows.hook: is the oldest palace still in royal use in Europe and doubled as Dorne in Game of Thrones
